decision.reason: Structure the bearing seat RLs already in the abutment takeoff (custom.takeoff_abutments group 4, Direct from DRG 202280-202282) into the new catalogue field bearings.items[*].seat_rl, so the substructure builder can place the bearing seats. The takeoff does not say which girder each drawing bearing serves (Missing-Flagged); the AI assigns them BY ORDER along the line of bearings (A: drawing bearing 4 = G1 ... 1 = G4; B: 1 = G1 ... 4 = G4), which the RLs confirm (seat RL rises with the deck crossfall in the same order as the girder soffits). No new values. NOTE F-5: the takeoff bearing POSITIONS along the line of bearings (A: 4977 / 2251 / -810 / -3706; B: -3708 / -812 / 2249 / 4976 mm) differ from the P1 bearing centres (girder line x support line) by 50-530 mm; the positions are NOT used. Engineer to resolve which is correct.
